tasks.title: CREA benchmark ingestion (Tangshan blast-furnace operating rate)
tasks.description: Ingest the Tangshan blast-furnace operating-rate benchmark from CREA's public WIND-sourced CSV: fetch, version a dated snapshot, parse (skip metadata headers, select the column by exact name), clean 0.00->NA, and emit a tidy parquet series plus retained auxiliary steel series. SCOPE NOTE: the spec also designed a validation/correlation module, but implementing it was premature because the NO2 predictor (attribution stage) does not exist yet to validate against. Validation was reverted to a scaffold and deferred to NOX-003 (post-attribution); the design remains recorded in the spec for reuse.

review.note: Delivered scope: benchmark ingestion only. Validation modules reverted on 2026-06-13 as premature (no predictor yet).

tasks.title: TROPOMI NO2 acquisition + AOI subset + QA (via openEO)
tasks.description: Acquire Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI L2 tropospheric NO2 over the Tangshan AOI for the TROPOMI era (2019-01 -> present) using openEO server-side spatial subsetting (not full-granule download: ~3,734 overpasses x ~609 MB = ~2.2 TB avoided -> ~0.2-1 GB kept). Use OFFL + RPRO for a version-consistent record and track the processor version per observation; apply the QA filter (qa_value >= 0.75 default); retain tropospheric NO2 column, qa, cloud fraction, averaging kernel, geolocation, precision per overpass; track per-period valid-coverage fraction; idempotent/resumable. Includes a verification step: on clear-sky high-NO2 days, render the NO2 field over the AOI with facility locations overlaid (and an optional optical thumbnail) to confirm enhancements co-locate with the steel sub-clusters. Gridding/compositing is NOX-002b; attribution is NOX-003.

review.note: 29 tests, ruff clean. Live-verified 2026-06-13 with developer CDSE creds: SENTINEL_5P_L2 collection confirmed (1 band/request, time dim 't', no qa_value/kernel -> gridded; cloud-based filtering); fetched 2023-06-01..06 over the AOI and rendered 2023-06-04 -> NO2 elevated over the central steel corridor (diffuse/regional, consistent with sub-pixel + BTH background). Averaging kernel deferred to a future L2 path (NOX-003). See open Q1.

tasks.title: TROPOMI NO2 gridding + temporal compositing (analysis-ready cube)
tasks.description: Assemble the per-overpass AOI NO2 from NOX-002a (already on a regular ~0.05x0.035 deg openEO grid) into a time-stacked, temporally-composited, coverage-screened analysis-ready cube in data/derived: harmonize overpasses onto a common grid, composite to a configured frequency (weekly default; monthly optional) by mean over valid cells, track per-cell and per-period valid-coverage, and apply the minimum-coverage threshold (cloud decision 2026-06-13) without interpolation. Because openEO already delivers a gridded product, this is harmonization + compositing, NOT swath oversampling (Beirle-style fine oversampling needs the raw L2 path, deferred to NOX-003). Also emits an interim AOI-mean weekly NO2 series (spatial mean, explicitly pre-attribution) matching the validation predictor contract, to enable a first end-to-end smoke of the validation engine. NO2-derived outputs are gitignored (not published). Resolution: native ~5 km (decision A, 2026-06-13) — adequate for the cluster signal.

review.note: 36 tests, ruff clean. Ran on the real (partial) store: weekly cube (232 slots) + interim AOI-mean series (76 rows), gitignored. Re-run 'noxus grid' after the full fetch completes; tune coverage thresholds (Q2) then.

tasks.title: Steel-sector NO2 activity signal + validation vs CREA (relative-index attribution, v1)
tasks.description: Derive a steel-sector activity signal for Tangshan from the gridded NO2 cube (NOX-002b) and validate it against the CREA blast-furnace operating-rate benchmark (NOX-001). v1 uses the RELATIVE-INDEX / cluster paradigm (Kim 2023), NOT flux divergence (Beirle, deferred to NOX-005). Pipeline: sample cells on a footprint around the steel facilities (data/derived/tangshan_steel_facilities.csv) rather than a flat AOI mean; subtract/normalize a regional background; apply meteorological normalization by ingesting ERA5 wind/PBL and regressing it out (Mao 2025 / Li 2024 approach) -- decided 2026-06-13 to mitigate the dominant weekly-ventilation confounder; deseasonalize (YoY/double-differencing or anchor normalization); emit a relative activity index; validate vs CREA with Pearson r + p-values and lead/lag tests; this revives the validation/correlation module deferred from NOX-001. REQUIREMENTS to treat explicitly: heating/non-heating confounder (steel NO2 share 42.5%->29.1%, SciRep 2024), policy/curtailment confounder (Li 2024), empirical sign verification for Tangshan (Montgomery 2018), attributable-fraction cap (~30-43%), relative (not absolute) signal due to TROPOMI low bias (-23..-33%). Success bar: r ~ 0.5-0.75 on deseasonalized series; honest NULL is an acceptable outcome (Morris&Zhang 2019). NO2-derived outputs gitignored.

review.note: Approved-with-nits across phase 1 (T1-T4), phase 2 (T5-T14) and the post-review ERA5->CDS delta; all nits (N1-N3, D1-D2) resolved. 90 tests, ruff clean. ERA5 source = Copernicus CDS (server-side AOI subset, per-year requests; ARCO rejected). Deseason default = yoy (double-diff demoted). First real end-to-end run produced an HONEST NEAR-NULL: raw levels negative (retrofit decoupling, Li 2024); after yoy detrending monthly r~0.19 (peak +0.29 at lag +6 mo), below the 0.5-0.75 bar -> valid reported null (Montgomery/Morris&Zhang). See docs/preliminary-results.html.

tasks.follow_ups: Optional v2 / follow-ups (not blocking done): model the retrofit trend explicitly (Li 2024 activity/policy/meteo decomposition); flux-divergence point-source attribution (NOX-005); public curtailment calendar (Q6a); re-run the full chain after the complete TROPOMI fetch and tune footprint/coverage thresholds.

tasks.title: Steel emission-intensity (decoupling) model + full-series re-run
tasks.description: Additive increment on NOX-003. NOX-003 produced a two-layer result: footprint NO2 correlates NEGATIVELY with the CREA blast-furnace operating rate in levels (monthly r~-0.35) and only weakly positive after blind yoy detrending (r~0.19, below the 0.5-0.75 bar). The negative-levels relationship is the signature of DECOUPLING (emission intensity / NOx-per-tonne falls secularly faster than activity rises; retrofits/policy, Li 2024). Blind difference filters under-remove (yoy) or erase (double-diff) that trend. This task models emission intensity EXPLICITLY: fit a smoothness-controlled secular trend s(t) on the meteo-normalised footprint signal and define the activity proxy as the residual (Li 2024 activity/intensity/meteo decomposition). Smoothness is selected by out-of-sample / blocked time-series cross-validation on the NO2 series ALONE -- never against the benchmark (anti-p-hacking, NFR-102) -- and a smoothness-sensitivity sweep is reported so any signal is shown robust, not an artefact of one smoothing choice. The secular trend is emitted as a reportable diagnostic (the decoupling), not discarded; the report states both the negative levels relationship and the residual relationship with CIs. Second half: the DEFERRED full-series re-run -- once the complete TROPOMI fetch + rebuilt cube exist, re-run the chain on the longer series and tune footprint radius + coverage thresholds on the complete coverage distribution, resolving NOX-003 Q1/Q5 and NOX-002b Q2. ADDITIVE ONLY: all existing deseason methods (yoy/stl/yoy-double-diff/none) and CLI behaviour are retained for replicability; intensity-model is a new selectable method. Relative-index discipline, attributable-fraction cap, honest-null and flux-divergence-deferred (NOX-005) all carry over unchanged. The full-series result is the go/no-go gate for NOX-005.

review.note: Approve T1-T9 (core method, dual-sign decoupling report, gates, figures). 107 tests, ruff clean. Anti-p-hacking verified: fit_intensity_trend takes no benchmark arg, CV scores on NO2 alone, planted-null sweep flat across df. Real partial-cube result: levels r=-0.35 (decoupling confirmed), intensity-model residual monthly r~0.14 (peak 0.19), comparable to yoy, below the 0.5-0.75 bar -> honest near-null persists; methodological gain is removing the difference-filter degree of freedom. T10 (full-series re-run + coverage tuning) is DATA-GATED on the complete TROPOMI fetch (cube partial); the cube-completeness gate (ERR-103) and radius sweep are in place. T11 docs partly done (preliminary-results.html, decision log, history, project-map); methods note optional.

tasks.follow_ups: RESOLVED 2026-06-14 (full-series arbiter, see history): rebuilt the complete cube (389 wks) + ran harmonic-K1 -> weak/null on average (weekly r=0.07, monthly 0.13) but regime-dependent (rolling-18mo peak r=0.76 @2023-06); catalyst null. The full series does not rescue the signal. Remaining: regime-conditioned modelling, flux divergence (NOX-005), or a multi-overpass sensor (GEMS, next spec). Q1/Q5 coverage tuning still open but low-priority.

tasks.title: Steel NO2 event catalyst (production-event detection -> market lead)
tasks.description: PARADIGM SHIFT (developer-directed 2026-06-13): stop using the cluster NO2 as a continuous tracker of the BF operating rate (NOX-003/003.1 showed it is a weak below-bar tracker) and use it as a CATALYST / EVENT MARKER. Detect discrete production events -- sharp surges/drops in cluster NO2 (curtailment start/end, sudden shutdowns/restarts) -- on the NOX-003.1 intensity-detrended + meteo-normalised residual, and test whether they (a) LEAD the official production print and (b) precede moves in steel-exposed markets. Why it fits: a catalyst lives in the tails (large deviations), so a low overall r is irrelevant; Tangshan events are discrete/sharp; and the slow decoupling trend that killed the continuous correlation does not create sudden jumps (removed once via the NOX-003.1 residual). Pipeline: event detection (robust anomaly + change-point, coverage-screened, STRENGTHENED meteo control = ventilation index + stagnation flag so a still-air spike is not an event -- the cheap in-framework lever for 'better weather correlation', NOT flux-divergence which is deferred NOX-005) -> ground-truth production events (CREA BF-rate jumps COMBINED WITH a public curtailment calendar) -> event-study match (precision/recall/lead time, not Pearson r) -> market event-study (cumulative abnormal returns around events) for THREE instrument families: Chinese ferrous futures (SHFE rebar/DCE iron ore/coking coal), global miners (BHP/RIO/VALE), and a China steel ETF/equities -> catalyst report. DISCIPLINE: strict no-look-ahead (causal baselines; trade at next session after overpass+latency), multiple-testing transparency (fix defaults before viewing returns), public/free data only (Chinese ferrous futures lack a clean free API -> Q1: lead with miners+ETF, ferrous as best-effort exchange-settlement snapshot or deferred), honest NULL is a valid outcome (Morris&Zhang 2019). NO2-derived events + market price snapshots gitignored. Statistical power benefits from the full TROPOMI fetch (NOX-003.1 T10).

review.note: Full catalyst implemented (events/groundtruth/market/study/report + CLI). 124 tests, ruff clean. Deep-review focus holds: NO-LOOK-AHEAD (causal expanding median/MAD; guard test; trade at overpass+latency) and MULTIPLE-TESTING (defaults fixed pre-returns; n_tests recorded) verified; ventilation/stagnation meteo screen rejects weather spikes; coverage screen; confirmed-vs-unconfirmed split; public/free yfinance only (ferrous deferred Q1); NO2 events + price snapshots gitignored. Real partial-cube run (live yfinance): HONEST NULL -- 25 NO2 events, 4/47 production matched (precision 0.16, recall 0.09, median lead -2 d), market CARs straddle zero. Machinery correct; event-marker weak on partial data -> full-fetch re-run + tuning is the decisive test.

tasks.follow_ups: Non-blocking: re-run after the full TROPOMI fetch (NOX-003.1 T10) + tune z-threshold/match-window/study-window on the longer series; assemble the public curtailment calendar (Q4); add Chinese ferrous futures via exchange daily-settlement snapshot (Q1); optional event-timeline / CAR / precision-recall figures + a docs/ result note. The full-series catalyst result also informs the NOX-005 (flux-divergence) go/no-go.

tasks.title: Flux-divergence point-source attribution (Beirle) -- deferred phase
tasks.description: DEFERRED future phase (decided 2026-06-13, phased-hybrid). Point-source NOx attribution via NO2 flux divergence (Beirle 2021/2023): flux = TVCD x ERA5 wind, divergence isolates the local source term, with chemical-loss and plume-height corrections (PAL product, v2). Requires a RAW L2 swath acquisition path (NOX-002a delivered the openEO gridded product, not raw swath needed for fine oversampling) plus ERA5 winds. Known to resolve poorly in high-background / complex-wind regions like industrial NE China -- expected to be hard at Tangshan; that risk is the reason it is a separate phase after the relative-index v1 (NOX-003) establishes whether any signal exists.

approval.note: Developer approved verbally ("si") to proceed, starting with the T1 feasibility gate only. Q2 (server-class compute for a full run) deferred to a post-T1 decision with measured cost in hand; T1 downloads only a bounded laptop-feasible subset and verifies the Q1 free CDSE L2 access path live.

tasks.status_note: SPEC_READY 2026-08-27: full SDD spec authored (REQ-001..015, NFR-001..008, EDGE-001..007, ERR-001..006, AC-001..008, AT1..8 + edge/err/reg, tasks T1..T14). 0 blocking open questions. T1 = feasibility gate on a bounded laptop-feasible subset, benchmark-blind, three-way go/no-go (GO / GO-degraded / NO-GO honest-null), also measures the compute/storage profile and stops the build on NO-GO. Two decision-shaping items for the developer at approval: Q1 raw-L2 free access path (new CDSE OData/S3 route for S5P_*_L2__NO2___ swath; NOX-002a delivered only the gridded openEO product) and Q2 expected method-hardness + server-class compute for a full run (NO-GO realistic at Tangshan; ~tens of GB raw). New additive noxus/fluxdiv/ + noxus/data/tropomi_l2.py + FluxDivergenceConfig + CLI fetch-l2 / flux-divergence[--probe]; relative-index pipeline untouched. Reuses NOX-008 robust significance + align_series + ERA5 + facility footprints byte-for-byte. This is the DL-A root-cause attempt (a null here closes DL-A decisively). Awaiting human approval (only the developer moves to human_approved).
tasks.verdict: POWERED NO-GO / honest null (T1 feasibility gate, single + extended multi-overpass). Flux divergence (Beirle) cannot separate a Tangshan steel point source from the advected North-China-Plain background. Decisive SNR-vs-N curve on real free-CDSE raw-L2 (4 one-per-day overpasses): field noise averaged down 3.4x (3.62e-08 -> 1.07e-08, faster than 1/sqrt(N) - the oversampling works as theory predicts) while source-vs-background SNR stayed FLAT ~+0.27 (< 1.5 floor); the numerator falls in lockstep with the noise -> no persistent source term. Co-location persists (1.8-2.3x, expected: plants in the NO2 core) but is not a separable source. A planted-source control confirms the same machinery makes SNR climb with N when a real source exists, so this is a powered null, not an n=1 artefact. Closes the DL-A revisit condition decisively. FIFTH convergent null (NOX-009/011/012/013/005). Q1: free CDSE raw-L2 OData path verified live. Q2: full run ~2.3 TB server-class, not justified. Honest limit: 4 of ~10-12 authorised overpasses completed (CDSE zipper throttled ~1.6 MB/s); decisive because SNR scales only ~sqrt(N) and is already flat. T2-T14 intentionally not built (spec-anticipated terminal state of a NO-GO gate). T1 infra kept as dormant scaffolding.

review.notes: T1 powered honest-null closeout APPROVED; no blocking findings. Crux validated: SNR numerator (location contrast median(E_footprint)-median(E_background)) and denominator (1.4826*MAD(E_background)) are computed independently (not algebraically linked), and a planted-source control test shows SNR rises with N when a real source exists while a background-only test stays flat -> the flat real-data SNR is a true null. Benchmark-blind (CREA never opened in the fluxdiv path); frozen FluxDivergenceConfig; reused modules (robust.py/leadlag.py/preprocess.py/attribution/source.py/data/era5.py/data/tropomi.py) byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff 74cae87..HEAD empty); relative-index pipeline untouched; public/free only (host allowlist refuses paid sources, ERR-005); secrets by env-var name only, never read/logged; raw L2 granules gitignored. 293 tests pass, ruff clean. Non-blocking finding 1 (throttle disclosure missing from the artefact) resolved by the documenter. Docs re-check CLEAR: exploration-results §13 (fifth null), history, project-map, data-access (free CDSE raw-L2 OData path + CDSE credential names), decision-log DL-A closed decisively (developer approved DL-A closure only; no architecture-decisions entry, as directed).

tasks.title: Daily NO2 aggregation + Prophet decomposition (trend + yearly + weekly)
tasks.description: Build a DAILY NO2 footprint series (re-aggregate the per-overpass store at freq=D, coverage-screened, never interpolated) and apply a PROPHET decomposition (piecewise-linear trend + yearly + weekly Fourier seasonality) to (a) remove the secular emission-intensity decline AND calendar seasonality in one model, and (b) exploit the day-of-week cycle for SOURCE SEPARATION: steel is baseload (flat across the week) while traffic/other carry a weekly cycle, so removing the weekly term raises steel's variance share -- the one temporal lever (short of flux divergence NOX-005) that can beat the ~40% mean-share SNR ceiling. Motivated by the deep exploration (docs/exploration-results.html): harmonic Fourier lifts best-regime r to 0.78 but the 40% MEAN share caps a level estimator; the weekly cycle is only visible at daily resolution. FEASIBILITY VERIFIED 2026-06-13: 2617 overpasses (2019->present, ~1/day); daily footprint = 1984 valid days (73%) after cloud screening, balanced across weekdays (Mon 290..Sun 270); prophet 1.3.0 installed. Pipeline: daily cube/footprint -> Prophet (deterministic MAP, uncertainty_samples=0, observed-only residual) -> weekday source-separation diagnostic -> compare residual vs BF (full/regime/lead-lag) alongside yoy/STL/intensity/harmonic -> re-run NOX-004 catalyst on the cleaner residual. DISCIPLINE: in-sample fit is diagnostic only; any lead/market claim uses a CAUSAL rolling refit (no look-ahead); prophet lazy-imported with the harmonic method as the dependency-free fallback; honest NULL acceptable; SNR ceiling recorded; daily NO2-derived gitignored.

review.note: Daily NO2 footprint (re-aggregate at freq=D; 1984/2720 valid, 73%, weekdays balanced) + Prophet decomposition (trend+yearly+weekly, deterministic MAP, lazy-imported, harmonic fallback). 133 tests, ruff clean. HONEST NULL on the marginal value: weekly component FLAT (0.5% variance, weekday profile ~0) -> steel baseload, no weekly cycle to separate (also limited by the single ~13:30 overpass); daily-Prophet residual best-regime r=0.65 < harmonic-K1 weekly 0.78 and intensity 0.73; yearly-only ~= yearly+weekly; no usable quarterly/four-month cycle (BF sub-annual power ~semiannual = heating-season curtailment, an annual harmonic). harmonic-K1 stays the method of record. Partial/non-blocking: causal-guard test (AC-006) + catalyst re-run on the Prophet residual deferred (no lead/market claim is made from a null).

tasks.follow_ups: Non-blocking: revive the weekly source-separation lever only with a multi-overpass/geostationary sensor (e.g. GEMS) that resolves the diurnal/weekday cycle; otherwise the full TROPOMI fetch + the event/regime framing remain the path. Causal rolling-refit + catalyst re-run on the Prophet residual deferred (null marginal value -> no predictive claim made).

tasks.title: GEMS (geostationary) NO2 acquisition + AOI clip + QA (diurnal successor to TROPOMI)
tasks.description: New acquisition route (style of NOX-002a, but for GEMS instead of TROPOMI) to obtain a DIURNAL NO2 predictor over Tangshan from GEMS (Geostationary Environment Monitoring Spectrometer, on GEO-KOMPSAT-2B, KR) -- the first geostationary air-quality sounder, ~8 daytime scans/day over East Asia. WHY: GEMS resolves the diurnal / day-of-week cycle, reviving the source-separation lever (flat steel baseload vs cyclical traffic) that NOX-006 proved INVISIBLE to TROPOMI's single ~13:30 overpass (weekly term flat, 0.5% variance). This is the one temporal lever (short of flux divergence, NOX-005) that can lift steel's VARIANCE share above the ~40% mean-share SNR ceiling; it does NOT change that ceiling for a levels estimator. CENTRAL VIABILITY FINDING (web research 2026-06-14): unlike TROPOMI (openEO filter_bbox) and ERA5 (CDS area), the NIER-ESC distribution channels (Open-API getFileDateList/getFileList/getFileItem, SFTP, no-login web<=20GB/40-file) deliver FULL GRANULES (full ~5000x5000 km field of regard) -- there is NO server-side AOI subset. So we download full granules and clip the Tangshan AOI client-side; the kept volume is tiny but the transient DOWNLOAD volume is the cost and its magnitude is unmeasured (per-granule byte size not publicly documented; estimate order 1-4 TB over ~13k granules). Product: L2 NO2 NetCDF4/HDF5 with tropospheric + total column, QA flag, averaging kernel, precision; versions v2.x->v4.0.1; coverage ~Oct-2021-> (shorter than TROPOMI 2019->). Tangshan is off-nadir (~9.6deg W of the 128E sub-satellite point, near the 45N FOR edge) -> coarser-than-nominal pixels, cluster-usable not per-plant. Spec gates the build on a T1 measurement spike (download one granule, measure size/structure/Tangshan-footprint/fields/version, record go/no-go vs a download budget). SCOPE DECISION (2026-06-14): NOT the full mission -- default acquisition scope is a climatologically-stable autumn window (Sep-Oct, primary year 2023; optional Sep-Oct 2024 same-season replication) to test whether a weekly NO2 component exists under near-constant meteorology. Early autumn = post-monsoon + pre-heating-season -> low synoptic noise (weekly cycle not swamped), no residential-heating NO2 confounder (cleaner steel<->traffic separation), low cloud (balanced GEMS coverage across weekdays + the ~8 daily scans), good 39.6N sun angle. Chinese public holidays (esp. Golden Week 1-7 Oct) flagged per scan and excluded/modelled in the downstream weekday profile (they break the 7-day cycle). Bounds download to ~50-150 GB/window; full mission opt-in. Effective resolution over Tangshan ~10 km (off-nadir; L3 documented ~5 km Korea / ~10 km elsewhere) -- GEMS' gain is diurnal frequency, not spatial resolution. API key by env var only (GEMS_API_KEY), never committed. Downstream diurnal/weekly compositing + source-separation + re-running NOX-003.1/004/006 on the GEMS residual = future NOX-009, out of scope here.
tasks.blocked_reason: Full-granule download with no server-side AOI subset -> transient volume plausibly multi-TB; per-granule size unmeasured. By developer decision (2026-06-14) the build/run is deferred to a server-style machine (bandwidth + scratch). Spec is complete and reviewable; the T1 measurement spike gates the build (go/no-go) once started. Developer moves to human_approved when ready to run.

tasks.title: Spatial-scale sensitivity of the NO2<->steel signal (AOI extent x grid resolution, autocorrelation-robust)
tasks.description: Test whether the weak/null NO2<->BF steel coupling is an artefact of one fixed spatial scale, by sweeping TWO scale axes over the EXISTING analysis-ready cube (data/derived/no2/no2_cube_w.nc; 30x51 cells at native ~0.035x0.055 deg, wide AOI) and recomputing the correlation with HONEST significance. Axis 1 = AOI extent: the default 0.25 deg buffer (DEFAULT_AOI_BUFFER_DEG) vs the 0.10 deg tight buffer (TIGHT_AOI_BUFFER_DEG) -- a strict spatial subset (clip), testing the source-isolation intuition (tighter AOI = less Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei background dilution; steel is only ~30-43% of Tangshan NO2, Wen 2024). Axis 2 = grid resolution: native vs block-averaged to ~0.1 deg and ~0.25 deg -- AGGREGATION ONLY (mean over cell blocks, never interpolation), consistent with the 2026-06-13 native-resolution decision which rejected interpolating to a FINER grid; coarsening by averaging is the permitted, information-preserving direction and is exactly the Parubets & Naito (2025) experiment. For each (extent x resolution) scale, re-derive the footprint/AOI-mean NO2 signal, run the existing deseasonalize variants (level / intensity-residual / yoy / stl), align to the CREA BF operating rate, and compute Pearson r + lead-lag. Judge significance with an AUTOCORRELATION-ROBUST test (first-order + full-order/Newey-West effective sample size, moving-block bootstrap CI of r, block-permutation null p) -- prototyped in analysis/autocorr_significance.py and promoted to noxus/validation -- plus a Benjamini-Hochberg FDR multiple-testing correction across the scale x variant x lag grid. GOAL: empirically test the Parubets scale warning (significant at 0.25 deg, lost/sign-flipped at 0.1 deg) on OUR Tangshan steel data, and whether a tighter AOI rescues the signal. Honest NULL is an acceptable, designed-for outcome (Morris & Zhang 2019); the result hardens the conclusion from 'no signal at one scale' to 'no robust signal at any reasonable scale' (or surfaces a scale where it appears). Builds on the 2026-06-14 exploratory probe (analysis/autocorr_significance.py). NOTE on the analogy: our setup is a single AOI-mean time series, so 'resolution' here = how coarsely we average within the AOI before the footprint/background contrast -- an ANALOGUE of Parubets' cross-prefecture panel, stated as an assumption, not an identity. NO2-derived scale outputs gitignored; small stats + figures committable.

review.note: Approved, no blocking findings. Verified against actual code/artifacts: full REQ/NFR/AC traceability; two-axis sweep as specified (Axis 1 clip 0.25 vs 0.10 buffer; Axis 2 coarsen_cube block-mean over {native,0.10,0.15,0.25} deg, AGGREGATION ONLY -- no interpolation-to-finer path, ERR-002 raises when finer than native); robust machinery real and used (robust_corr effective-N 1st-order + Newey-West, moving-block bootstrap CI, block-permutation null; bh_fdr per lag_kind family; AT3 naive over-rejects AR(1) while robust holds near alpha, AT4 recovers planted signal); benchmark-blind (deseasonalize carries no benchmark arg); result faithfully supported (scale_sensitivity.csv = 128 rows, 0 robust, 34 fragile naive-only, all fdr_reject=False, min p_fdr=0.196, matches findings file + follow_up); docs (exploration-results, architecture-decisions, history, project-map) updated/accurate; reused modules untouched in 433b49c. 248 tests pass, ruff clean.
nits: N1 ERR-001 (missing-cube) has an actionable FileNotFoundError path but no dedicated unit test
N2 extra figures under docs/figures/nox008/ beyond the spec's docs/figures/exploration/ outputs -- additive, in scope

Spatial scale closed as a lever for the relative-index paradigm -> remaining avenues are flux divergence (NOX-005), GEMS diurnal sensor (NOX-007), or regime/event framing. Result: data/derived/scale_sensitivity.csv + docs/figures/exploration/scale_sensitivity_findings.txt + 16 figures.

tasks.title: NO2 variance decomposition (industrial share of change-variance vs imported mean-share ceiling)
tasks.description: SPEC_READY 2026-07-06 (spec authored: requirements/design/tasks/assumptions/open-questions/acceptance-tests; 0 blocking open questions; awaiting human approval). Critique-driven (critique #4: 'level share vs variance share'). The project's SNR ceiling is currently an IMPORTED MEAN-LEVEL share (Wen 2024: steel = 30-43% of Tangshan NO2 concentration), used to argue the ~0.63 (sqrt(0.40)) correlation ceiling for a LEVEL estimator. But a change/activity detector lives in the COVARIANCE OF CHANGES, not the mean level; the mean share is the wrong ceiling and was never measured on our data. This task measures EMPIRICALLY what fraction of the variance of the meteo-normalised, deseasonalised footprint NO2 (footprint-minus-background, NOX-003.1 residual) is attributable to (a) the shared regional mode (background ring 25-60 km), (b) the meteo term (variance explained by the ERA5 regression), (c) the steel-footprint-specific local residual, and (d) unexplained noise -- a variance budget, on first differences and on the deseasonalised residual, at weekly and (NOX-006) daily resolution. Deliverable: a variance-partition table + the implied SNR ceiling for a CHANGE detector, contrasted with the level ceiling, to reframe whether the near-null (weekly r=0.07) is genuinely SNR-bound or target/method-bound. ANTI-P-HACKING (NFR, carries from NOX-003.1): the decomposition is computed on NO2 + meteo + background ALONE, never regressed against the CREA benchmark; no smoothing/threshold is selected against CREA. Pure analysis on the EXISTING cube (data/derived/no2/) -- no new acquisition. Honest result acceptable: it either shows headroom (change-variance share >> level share -> the null is method/target-bound, motivating NOX-010/011) or confirms the ceiling (-> the null is physical). NO2-derived outputs gitignored; small stats + figures committable. NOTE: distinct from the informal 'future NOX-009' GEMS-residual analysis mentioned in NOX-007 (that is blocked behind GEMS and will take a later id).

tasks.title: Non-linear meteo deweathering + stagnation conditioning (beyond linear ERA5 regress-out)
tasks.description: Critique-driven (critiques #5 'condition vs model wind' and #6 'the residual noise is meteorology, not traffic'). The continuous pipeline currently regresses ERA5 covariates (u10, v10, blh, wind_speed) out of the footprint NO2 LINEARLY (meteo_form=linear). Boundary-layer height and ventilation act MULTIPLICATIVELY on surface concentration, so a linear form under-removes meteo variance; and conditioning on meteorology (stagnant vs ventilated subsamples) was only used in the NOX-004 catalyst, never in the continuous signal. This task adds (1) a NON-LINEAR deweathering normalisation (random-forest / gradient-boosted meteo model in the style of Grange & Carslaw 2019 'rmweather', with BLH x wind interactions and a seasonal term), emitting a meteo-normalised footprint signal as an ADDITIVE, selectable method (meteo_form=rf), the existing linear form retained as default/fallback; and (2) a stagnation-conditioned robustness view (correlate on well-ventilated vs stagnant subsamples using a ventilation index + stagnation flag, reusing NOX-004's screen). SUCCESS TEST (pre-registered before viewing): does non-linear deweathering RAISE the footprint<->CREA correlation under the NOX-008 autocorrelation-robust significance (effective-N + Newey-West + moving-block bootstrap CI + block-permutation null + BH-FDR)? DISCIPLINE: the meteo model is fit on NO2 vs meteo ONLY, never against CREA (anti-p-hacking); cross-validated on the NO2 series alone; honest null acceptable (a linear form may already capture most meteo variance, in which case critique #6's 'residual is meteorology' is bounded). Likely new dependency scikit-learn (justify + lazy-import, harmonic/linear fallback if absent) -- open question. Depends on the meteo-normalisation stage (NOX-003) + robust significance (NOX-008) + ERA5 snapshot. NO2-derived outputs gitignored.

tasks.title: VIIRS thermal-anomaly independent benchmark (triangulate to break the target-vs-feature ambiguity)
tasks.description: Critique-driven (critique #1: the 'fraudulent target' -- the most letal critique, partly defused because the CREA benchmark is a commercial trader survey (WIND/Custeel), not official statistics, but its provenance is not independently verifiable and Chinese activity data is chronically massaged). CONVERSION into something actionable: triangulate NO2 against a HARD-TO-FALSIFY PHYSICAL activity proxy that no statistical office can dress up -- VIIRS thermal anomalies (nightfire / active-fire radiative power) over the catalogued Tangshan steel facilities (39 rows in data/derived/tangshan_steel_facilities.csv; the earlier "84" was a mis-count) (data/derived/tangshan_steel_facilities.csv). Blast furnaces, sinter plants and coke ovens are high-temperature combustion sources VIIRS detects from orbit. Acquire a free VIIRS thermal series (NOAA VIIRS Nightfire VNF and/or NASA FIRMS VNP14 active fire; source resolved in the spec) clipped to the facility footprints over the TROPOMI era, aggregate to the analysis frequency, and run the DECISIVE triangulation: (i) NO2 <-> VIIRS and (ii) CREA <-> VIIRS, with the NOX-008 autocorrelation-robust significance. LOGIC: if NO2 does not even track the physical heat of the furnaces -> the FEATURE is the weak link; if NO2 <-> VIIRS holds but CREA <-> VIIRS does not -> the TARGET (CREA) was the weak link, retroactively re-interpreting every prior near-null. This is the one lever against 'maquillaje': a space-based thermometer cannot be faked. NEW ACQUISITION path (style of NOX-002a): free/public data only, credentials by env-var reference only, resumable manifest, VIIRS-derived outputs gitignored. Honest null acceptable and INFORMATIVE either way. Heaviest of the roadmap on new data; independent of NOX-009/010.

tasks.verdict: T12 real-data run (2026-08-22): The 2023 rolling-r peak is consistent with a MULTIPLE-COMPARISONS ARTEFACT of the rolling window -- a valid, first-class honest-null finding (Morris & Zhang 2019). Headline (harmonic variant, 18-month/78-week window): peak r=0.276 at 2023-08-27; scan-maximum null observed=0.276 p=0.325 percentile=0.675 beyond_band=False (block=7, 341 windows, 2000 draws) -> unsurprising given the windows scanned. BH-FDR nuance (N-T12-1): the fixed-grid 'peak survives BH-FDR: True' is carried by the 52-week SECONDARY cells (p_fdr~0.0078); the 18-month HEADLINE peak is itself marginally NOT FDR-significant (p_fdr~0.0516). Grid-FDR and scan-max are different multiplicity lenses; the scan-max governs the rolling-peak claim. Event-bound jackknife: CONTINUOUS coupling (full r=0.257 -> without top 3 events 0.349) -- not driven by a few large curtailment events. 2024 collapse: INTENSITY-DECOUPLING (calendar_shift=False, intensity_shift=True), consistent with the NOX-003.1 secular decline, not a curtailment-regime change. n_tests=6. tasks.title: Investment-grade activity nowcast (weekly surprise signal + independent-signal triangulation QC)
tasks.description: Developer-directed reframing (2026-07-12): the project's product is an INVESTMENT-GRADE signal, not a correlation study. Convert the physical activity measurement into a weekly, latency-aware NOWCAST of Tangshan steel activity expressed as a SURPRISE: deviation of the satellite-implied activity from an expectation baseline (own seasonal/trend model + last published official print), emitted as a causal z-score tradable at the next session after overpass + processing latency. FEATURE INPUT IS CONTINGENT ON THE ROADMAP: NOX-009 measured the steel-local share of NO2 change-variance at ~0 (93-95% regional common-mode), so the continuous NO2 residual alone is NOT a viable nowcast feature; the candidate features are (a) VIIRS thermal-anomaly series over the facility footprints (NOX-011) as primary physical activity proxy, (b) NO2 event/catalyst markers (NOX-004/NOX-012) for discrete curtailment starts/stops, and (c) NO2 continuous residual only as a contextual covariate. TRIANGULATION AS QC (from the 2026-07-12 discussion): cross-check the nowcast against hard-to-falsify quantities measured OUTSIDE China -- exporter-side iron-ore shipments (Pilbara Ports monthly tonnage to China, Vale shipments), Capesize/Baltic freight, coking-coal exports -- used as signal quality control and as the discrepancy-vs-official-statistics diagnostic (latent-factor / residual-analysis framing: periods where official prints diverge from the independent-signal consensus are flagged with uncertainty, NOT labelled 'fake'). INCUMBENT TEST: the benchmark to beat is the weekly Mysteel/WIND blast-furnace operating-rate survey (the CREA series) -- the nowcast must show INCREMENTAL information (earlier or orthogonal), else no edge exists. DISCIPLINE: strict no-look-ahead (causal baselines, publication-lag-aware alignment of official prints), anti-p-hacking (expectation model fit without reference to market returns), public/free data only, honest null acceptable. Scale caveat explicit: Tangshan ~13% of national steel; provincial (Hebei) statistics preferred where available. Derived series gitignored; small stats + figures committable.

tasks.title: Background-ring radius sensitivity (is the cluster-local ~0 share physics or ring self-subtraction?)
tasks.description: SPEC_READY 2026-08-28 (requirements/design/tasks/assumptions/open-questions/acceptance-tests authored; awaiting human approval). Paper critique C1 — the single most important missing control. The change-variance decomposition (NOX-009) subtracts a FIXED 25-60 km background ring, but the NOX-005 flux probe measures |U|=2.48 m/s and assumes tau=4 h, i.e. a ~36 km advection scale that lands in the MIDDLE of that ring. If the ring carries the cluster's own advected plume, subtracting it removes signal with background, and the fixed regional->meteo->local partition order books that shared variance to 'regional' BY CONSTRUCTION — so cluster-local ~= 0 could be a design artefact, making the paper's central claim circular. This task sweeps the ring inner/outer radii past the advection scale and re-runs the decomposition unchanged, so the ~0 share is either confirmed as physical or exposed as self-subtraction. FEASIBILITY (measured 2026-08-28, read-only): the existing weekly cube reaches 124 km from the cluster centroid; a 60-120 km ring yields 759 valid cells (vs 288 for 25-60 km), all 8 azimuthal octants populated, mean valid-week fraction 0.99 — NO new acquisition required.

tasks.title: Provincial/national benchmark arm (does the pipeline recover a wider-scale steel signal it cannot recover locally?)
tasks.description: SPEC_READY 2026-08-28 (requirements/design/tasks/assumptions/open-questions/acceptance-tests authored; awaiting human approval). Paper critique C2 — the cheap test that discriminates between the two live explanations for the near-null. Explanation A (the paper's): the SPATIAL SCALE is the binding constraint — the Tangshan cluster term is not separable from the regional common mode. Explanation B: the PIPELINE is broken, or the CREA trader survey is a poor target. Scoring the SAME benchmark-blind NO2 features against wider-scale steel output separates them: if the Tangshan NO2 feature tracks NATIONAL/PROVINCIAL steel activity better than it tracks Tangshan's own BF rate, that is positive evidence FOR the regional-common-mode reading and it simultaneously reduces the feature-vs-target ambiguity that NOX-011 (VIIRS) failed to resolve. If it tracks neither, the problem is upstream and the paper's spatial interpretation is not supported. FEASIBILITY (measured 2026-08-28, read-only): benchmark_auxiliary.parquet ALREADY carries three CREA national series — 'Blast Furnace Starting Rate (247)' weekly n=383 since 2019 (a direct national counterpart to the Tangshan BF rate, same variable and publisher), plus decadal (10-day) national crude-steel and pig-iron daily-average output, n=260 each. Arm A therefore needs NO acquisition. Arm B (NBS Hebei-provincial monthly crude steel) needs a new public fetcher and is gated behind a T1 probe.

approval.notes: Developer said "ok perfecto, tienes permiso" 2026-08-28 after reviewing both specs. NOX-016 Q1 (blocking) not answered explicitly -> proceeding with the spec default and recommendation: option (a), run the T1 NBS probe first and build Arm B only on GO.

The committed cube (AOI buffer 0.25 deg) reaches only 63 km from the cluster centroid with full 360-degree coverage (corner max ~126 km), so the 60-120 km ring was four corner wedges, not an annulus -- and the deseason local share was still RISING monotonically at the outermost ring available, which cannot be read either way. It also repairs BY PRE-REGISTRATION the NOX-015 verdict-rule defect: Rule A (LEVEL, carried over unchanged for comparability) and Rule B (RISE, the corrected formulation) are both fixed before the run, alongside a plateau criterion -- the actual reason the wider cube was acquired. tasks.origin: Recorded NOX-015 follow-up: 'needs a cube wider than ~124 km since the rise had not plateaued', plus the NOX-015 review defect on the pre-registered verdict rule.

review.note: Wide cube acquired in full at buffer 1.25 deg: 92 batches, 2741 overpasses, 0 failed batches, 204 MB, 79.5 min; grid 66x109 at the committed step. All seven rings are COMPLETE ANNULI (0 empty octants), which the 0.25-deg AOI could not form beyond 63 km. VERDICT domain-limited: the weekly deseason share rises monotonically 0.0070 -> 0.0612 (x8.7) with a bootstrap CI excluding zero from 40-80 km outward, the regional share falls 0.95 -> 0.76, and at the outermost ring the weekly deseason cell clears BOTH pre-registered materiality thresholds for the first time (level 0.0612, rise +0.0542) -- but alone, where the quorum is 2 of 4, and the share is STILL CLIMBING (+0.0123 vs a 0.01 plateau tolerance). The first-difference basis is a clamped zero at every radius. Net: quadrupling the AOI area and pushing the ring to 150 km did NOT produce convergence, so the ring radius does not settle over any domain this geography allows; past ~120 km the ring spans the Bohai Sea and the Tianjin plume, so a wider cube would confound the test rather than settle it. Two defects recorded and handled honestly: (1) the plateau rule was revised from a quorum to 'every measurable cell' after a pilot on 8 of 89 months showed clamped-at-zero cells satisfy a quorum by construction -- revised BEFORE the full run, disclosed with its provenance, and in the direction that makes domain-limited MORE reachable; (2) spec assumptions A2/A3 were false as written (wide grid offset sub-cell: 447 footprint cells not 448), tested rather than assumed via a registration check that reproduces every committed share to within 0.0035. 360 tests pass; ruff clean; paper 21 pp., 0 overfull.

tasks.follow_ups: Ring sweep closed as far as this geography allows; a still-wider cube is explicitly NOT recommended (past ~120 km the ring is a different air mass). Separating 'the ring escapes the plume' from 'the ring changes air mass' needs a directional/sectoral background, a different design. CREA/WIND provenance gap (NOX-016) stays open; C3-C7 unrun.
